name: Beam × Beam 1D estimate
definition: A radiance estimation technique using photon beams that avoids ray marching, offering better image quality than photon points while being computationally simpler than the 3D variant.
summary: Beam × Beam 1D estimate is a radiance estimation technique for participating media that merges camera and photon beam endpoints with a 1D spatial blur to efficiently compute in-scattered light without ray marching.
